messages:
Lea (People Ops): Heads-up: PTO accrual cadence is changing to biweekly starting 2025-07-01. This aligns accrual with payroll and reduces manual adjustments for new hires. :calendar:

Lea (People Ops): Summary:
- Frequency: accrual moves from monthly to biweekly (payroll-aligned).
- Rates: annual accrual rates unchanged.
- Cap: hard cap remains 240 hours.
- One-time carryover for 2025->2026: up to 40 hours if you hit the cap and cannot reasonably take time off due to project constraints; needs manager note.
- New hires: prorated on first biweekly paycheck; examples in the HR doc.
- Unpaid leave: accrual pauses after 30 consecutive unpaid days (exceptions possible with People Ops review).

Lea (People Ops): Actions for folks:
- Check your balance in Time Off portal by 2025-12-15 if you may exceed usage.
- Request an org-level exception via DM to People Ops with manager sign-off.
- Attend one of the Q&A sessions (link below).

Lea (People Ops): Full details and the Q&A signups are here: https://redwoodinference.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/PeopleOps/pages/PM-PT0-accrual-update

Sam (Engineering): Quick Q: If I extend unpaid parental leave to 6 weeks, does accrual stop immediately or after the 30 days you mentioned?

Priya (People Ops): Short answer: accrual pauses after 30 days of unpaid leave. Paid parental leave keeps accrual during the paid portion; unpaid extensions follow the 30-day rule. Ping me with specifics (manager + dates) and we can review.

Jordan (Finance): Note: Payroll will run a cutover test 2025-06-15 to validate biweekly posting and UI display. If you see transient incorrect balances during that week, file a ticket to payroll@redwoodinference.com with screenshots.

Tom (People Ops): Live Q&A sessions:
- 2025-06-20 10:00 PT
- 2025-06-24 15:00 CET
Recordings will be posted to the HR doc.

Sam (Engineering): Thanks, will join the PT session. :thumbsup:

Lea (People Ops): We'll add a small preview calculator in the Time Off portal so people can simulate biweekly accrual and projected year-end balance. DM People Ops or drop questions here if anything's unclear.
